# Small documents for flows

Invented documents in the form a document's repository holds them, for tests that need a document as its repository holds it. Every title and sentence is a synthetic example.

| Directory | Holds |
|---|---|
| `two-sections-ukr/` | a two-section procedure in Ukrainian |
| `two-sections-eng/` | the same shape in English |
| `with-parts-ukr/` | a Ukrainian document with one appendix and one attachment |

Each `document.md` is written as the platform writes it: the frontmatter's keys in a fixed order, every string quoted, one blank line before the body, one sentence per line.
